global_hotkey_modifiers.description: Modifier keys for the global search hotkey, e.g., 'Alt', 'Ctrl', 'Meta', or 'Alt+Ctrl'.

global_hotkey_key.description: Key for the global search hotkey, e.g., 'Space', 'F1'.

start_minimized.description: Whether Zeal should start minimized to the system tray.

check_for_updates.description: Whether Zeal should automatically check for application updates.

docsets_path.description: Custom path to the directory containing documentation sets. Leave empty for default location.
